messages:
marco: kicking off canary for embed-service v3.0 -> v3.1 (EU region only). change window 45m. start traffic 15% -> 60% if green. please watch p99_latency and error/5xx.

deploy-bot: canary initiated: embed-service:v3.1 at 15% (eu-west1). monitors: slo/embeds_p99, metric/http_5xx_rate, route:/v2/embeds latency. watchlist: partner-x, partner-y.

sara: noted. quick FYI v3.1 includes tokenizer tweak that should reduce token count for long prompts. could affect long-prompt tail.

pat: getting p99 spike in eu-west1 for /v2/embeds: p99 -> 1.8s from baseline 180ms. 5xx up from 0.02% -> 0.9% in last 3m. looks correlated to partner-x.

pat: query i ran:

```

sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="eu-west1",route="/v2/embeds",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (tenant)

```

returns tenant="partner-x" -> 7rps, others ~0.

sara: that's strange. tokenizer change shouldn't cause 5xx. could be memory pressure on a switchover path.

marco: decision: halt traffic increase. keep canary at 15%. enable region pin for eu-west1 -> v3.0 while we triage. @deploy-bot apply regional pin.

deploy-bot: ack. regional pin applied: region=eu-west1 -> embed-service:v3.0. canary paused, global traffic unchanged. emitted audit event and notif to #incidents.

pat: after pin 5xx for partner-x dropped to baseline within 90s. p99 returned to normal too. confirming routing table now routes eu-west1 to v3.0.

product: can we mark this in release notes as "regional regression observed: tokenizer path" and flag as follow-up? assign to @sara for triage.

sara: will open bug: "v3.1 tokenizer memory spike on long prompts -> 5xx in eu-west1". I'll add repro steps and attach recent logs. tagging @marco for context.

alerts-bot: alert suppression applied for tenant=partner-x and region=eu-west1 due to pin. suppression expires when pin removed.

marco: extending change window +2h to let infra and sara investigate and decide next steps. we'll reconvene before any unpause. thanks for the quick eyeballs :pray:
